individuals.title: Community Edition
individuals.quote: The open source Community Edition (CE).

individuals.title: Enterprise Edition
individuals.quote: The open core Enterprise Edition (EE).

individuals.title: GitLab operates under a single codebase
individuals.quote: The EE repository has been archived. GitLab now operates under a single codebase.

individuals.title: GNU/Linux
individuals.quote: A typical install of GitLab is on GNU/Linux

individuals.title: Kubernetes
individuals.quote: growing number of deployments also use the Kubernetes platform

individuals.title: GitLab.com
individuals.quote: The largest known GitLab instance is on GitLab.com, which is deployed using our official GitLab Helm chart and the official Linux package.

individuals.title: GitLab Helm chart
individuals.quote: The largest known GitLab instance is on GitLab.com, which is deployed using our official GitLab Helm chart and the official Linux package.

individuals.title: Official Linux package
individuals.quote: The largest known GitLab instance is on GitLab.com, which is deployed using our official GitLab Helm chart and the official Linux package.

individuals.title: NGINX
individuals.quote: NGINX has an Ingress port for all HTTP requests and routes them to the appropriate sub-systems within GitLab.

individuals.title: Apache httpd
individuals.quote: A typical installation uses NGINX or Apache as a web server to proxy through GitLab Workhorse and into the Puma application server.

individuals.title: GitLab Workhorse
individuals.quote: GitLab Workhorse is a program designed at GitLab to help alleviate pressure from Puma.

individuals.title: Alleviate pressure from Puma
individuals.quote: GitLab Workhorse is a program designed at GitLab to help alleviate pressure from Puma.

individuals.title: Puma
individuals.quote: Puma is a Ruby application server that is used to run the core Rails Application that provides the user facing features in GitLab.

individuals.title: GitLab Rails application
individuals.quote: GitLab is a Ruby on rails application

individuals.title: Sidekiq
individuals.quote: Sidekiq is a Ruby background job processor that pulls jobs from the Redis queue and processes them.

individuals.title: Background jobs enable faster request/response cycle
individuals.quote: Background jobs allow GitLab to provide a faster request/response cycle by moving work into the background.

individuals.title: Redis
individuals.quote: Redis is packaged to provide a place to store:

individuals.title: PostgreSQL
individuals.quote: The GitLab application uses PostgreSQL for persistent database information

individuals.title: Bare Git repositories
individuals.quote: The bare repositories are located in `/home/git/repositories`.

individuals.title: GitLab API
individuals.quote: GitLab serves web pages and the GitLab API using the Puma application server.

individuals.title: GitLab Shell
individuals.quote: GitLab Shell is a program designed at GitLab to handle SSH-based `git` sessions, and modifies the list of authorized keys.

individuals.title: SSH keys file must never be manually edited
individuals.quote: The file in that location should never be manually edited.

individuals.title: Gitaly
individuals.quote: Gitaly is a service designed by GitLab to remove our need for NFS for Git storage in distributed deployments of GitLab

individuals.title: Remove need for NFS for Git storage
individuals.quote: Gitaly is a service designed by GitLab to remove our need for NFS for Git storage in distributed deployments of GitLab

individuals.title: Gitaly API
individuals.quote: provides an API to the GitLab web app to get attributes from Git

individuals.title: Shared files not an option on Kubernetes
individuals.quote: Shared files are not an option for the application running on the Kubernetes platform.

individuals.title: Kubernetes services may run in complete isolation
individuals.quote: This is not the case for services running in Kubernetes, where services might be running in complete isolation, or only accessible through specific ports.

individuals.title: Exchange information through APIs, not files
individuals.quote: Services that need to have access to the same files, need to be able to exchange information through the appropriate APIs. Whenever possible, this should not be done with files.

individuals.title: API-first philosophy
individuals.quote: components written with the API-first philosophy in mind are compatible with both methods

individuals.title: Kubernetes compatibility first
individuals.quote: all new features and services must be written to consider Kubernetes compatibility first.

individuals.title: Distribution team
individuals.quote: reach out to the Distribution team.

individuals.title: GitLab Pages
individuals.quote: GitLab Pages is a feature that allows you to publish static websites directly from a repository in GitLab.

individuals.title: GitLab agent server
individuals.quote: GitLabKas[GitLab agent server] --> GitLabWorkhorse

individuals.title: Registry
individuals.quote: The registry is what users use to store their own Docker images.

individuals.title: Mailroom
individuals.quote: Mailroom --> Redis

individuals.title: Grafana
individuals.quote: Grafana is an open source, feature rich metrics dashboard and graph editor for Graphite, Elasticsearch, OpenTSDB, Prometheus, and InfluxDB.

individuals.title: Consul
individuals.quote: Consul is a tool for service discovery and configuration.

individuals.title: Database Migrations
individuals.quote: Migrations --> PostgreSQL

individuals.title: PgBouncer
individuals.quote: Lightweight connection pooler for PostgreSQL.

individuals.title: Redis Sentinel
individuals.quote: Sentinel <--> Redis

individuals.title: Praefect
individuals.quote: Praefect is a transparent proxy between each Git client and the Gitaly coordinating the replication of

individuals.title: Praefect PostgreSQL
individuals.quote: Praefect <--> PraefectPGSQL[PostgreSQL]

individuals.title: Object storage
individuals.quote: GitLab requires an S3-compatible object storage for storing data such as CI artifacts, LFS objects, uploads, and container registry images.

individuals.title: GitLab requires S3-compatible object storage
individuals.quote: GitLab is compatible with any object storage provider that offers full S3 API compatibility.

individuals.title: Prometheus
individuals.quote: Prometheus is a time-series tool that helps GitLab administrators expose metrics about the individual processes used to provide GitLab the service.

individuals.title: Redis Exporter
individuals.quote: Redis Exporter is designed to give specific metrics about the Redis process to Prometheus so that we can graph these metrics in Grafana.

individuals.title: PostgreSQL Exporter
individuals.quote: `postgres_exporter` is the community provided Prometheus exporter that delivers data about PostgreSQL to Prometheus for use in Grafana Dashboards.

individuals.title: PgBouncer Exporter
individuals.quote: Prometheus exporter for PgBouncer. Exports metrics at 9127/metrics.

individuals.title: Node Exporter
individuals.quote: Node Exporter is a Prometheus tool that gives us metrics on the underlying machine (think CPU/Disk/Load).

individuals.title: GitLab Exporter
individuals.quote: GitLab Exporter is a process designed in house that allows us to export metrics about GitLab application internals to Prometheus.

individuals.title: Alertmanager
individuals.quote: Alert manager is a tool provided by Prometheus

individuals.title: SMTP Gateway
individuals.quote: SMTP[SMTP Gateway]

individuals.title: LDAP
individuals.quote: Puma -- TCP 369 --> LDAP

individuals.title: LDAP Authentication
individuals.quote: Authenticate users against centralized LDAP directory

individuals.title: Elasticsearch
individuals.quote: Elasticsearch is a distributed RESTful search engine built for the cloud.

individuals.title: Zoekt
individuals.quote: Zoekt --> Praefect

individuals.title: Sentry
individuals.quote: Sentry fundamentally is a service that helps you monitor and fix crashes in real time.

individuals.title: Jaeger
individuals.quote: Jaeger, inspired by Dapper and OpenZipkin, is a distributed tracing system.

individuals.title: GitLab Geo
individuals.quote: Geo is a premium feature built to help speed up the development of distributed teams by providing one or more read-only mirrors of a primary GitLab instance.

individuals.title: Geo reduces time to clone large repositories
individuals.quote: This mirror (a Geo secondary site) reduces the time to clone or fetch large repositories and projects, or can be part of a Disaster Recovery solution.

individuals.title: GitLab Runner
individuals.quote: GitLab Runner runs jobs and sends the results to GitLab.

individuals.title: GitLab CI/CD
individuals.quote: GitLab CI/CD is the open-source continuous integration service included with GitLab that coordinates the testing.

individuals.title: GitLab agent for Kubernetes
individuals.quote: The GitLab agent for Kubernetes is an active in-cluster

individuals.quote: GitLab AI Gateway is a standalone-service that will give access to AI features to all users of

individuals.quote: GitLab Duo Workflow Service is our agentic AI Features that is deployed via our Runway service

individuals.quote: Receives and revokes leaked secrets

individuals.title: Certificate Management
individuals.quote: TLS Settings, Let's Encrypt

individuals.quote: `/home/git/gitlab/log/` usually contains `application.log`, `production.log`, `sidekiq.log`, `puma.stdout.log`, `git_json.log`, and `puma.stderr.log`.

individuals.quote: Many other settings are better placed in the app itself, in `ApplicationSetting`.

individuals.quote: Managing settings in UI is usually a better user experience compared to managing configuration files.

individuals.quote: GitLab provides Rake tasks with which you see version information and run a quick check on your configuration to ensure it is configured properly within the application.
